description: Agent Memory: submit an export flow: how the principal gets an export (on their own, by asking, or not at all), its format (JSON, CSV, Markdown, plain text, HTML, PDF, a proprietary format only the agent reads, or another), the categories it covers, whether it includes the agent’s inferences marked as inferences and each item’s source, and how long it takes, plus optionally every category kept about the principal, what the export withholds with the reason and whether the principal is told, the stated time an export should take and the export requests seen with when each arrived and whether it was complete. The signed report says whether the principal can obtain everything remembered about them, in a readable form, inferences included, and whether anything is withheld, and names no export, a format only the agent reads, inferences left out, every category kept but silently missing from the export, everything withheld without telling the principal and every export delivered incomplete, then an export only on request, items without their source, every category withheld with the principal told, an export slower than the stated time and every request delivered late, with the fix for each. This reads whether the principal can take their memory with them: export claims checked against a provider’s terms are wever_export-evidence-check, whether an agent’s own identity works outside its platform is wever_identity-portability-check and whether a removal request clears memory everywhere is wever_memory-deletion-check. Verdict memory_locked, export_gaps, export_unverified or principal_can_take_it. POST /api/memory-export-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-memory-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-memory/.

available.description: How the principal gets an export: on their own, by asking, or not at all.

covers.description: The categories the export includes, such as preferences, task history and inferred traits.

format.description: The export format: JSON, CSV, Markdown, plain text, HTML, PDF, a proprietary format only the agent reads, or another.

includes_inferences.description: The export includes what the agent inferred about the principal, marked as inferences.

includes_sources.description: Each item comes with where it came from.

within.description: How long an export takes to arrive, such as 2 days.

flow.description: The export flow, such as download my data.

held.description: Every category kept about the principal, to compare with what the export covers.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

requests.description: Export requests seen, with when each arrived.

complete.description: The export delivered held everything kept about the principal.

target.description: How soon an export should arrive, such as 7 days.

name.description: What is left out of the export, by category.

principal_told.description: The export tells the principal it is left out and why.

name: wever_memory-export-check
title: Memory export check
